sections.heading: Learning Point 3
sections.content: While making things with locally available materials students learn useful methods of sustainable development, including refuse, reduce, reuse, repurpose and recycle (the 5 R s) so that they can make responsible decisions.

sections.heading: Learning Point 4
sections.content: By making things with their own hands, they develop a deeper appreciation for the materials we use in everyday life, and also learn to connect and care for their environment.

sections.content: In Grade 5, this unit invites students to explore how everyday things, like energy and cloth, are made and used.

sections.heading: Learning Point 6
sections.content: Through simple activities and local examples, they learn how energy enables movement and light, how threads become fabric, and why reusing things and clean energy matter.

sections.heading: Learning Point 8
sections.content: Note to the Teacher The unit consists of two chapters: Chapter 7 ‘Energy — How Things Work’ and Chapter 8 ‘Clothes — How Things are Made’.
